notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.3
notes.content: Changed the UI scaling to accomodate different screen resolutions. (This should fix the build menu not beeing fully visible, when not using 16:9 or 16:10 resolutions)

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2
notes.content:
- collecting resources from storage now stops when your hand is full
- minor stability improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1 - Collect directly from Storage
notes.content:
You can now collect resources directly from storage chests!
(To prevent accidental collecting, this only works when starting collecting directly on it.)

Further changes:
- The UI scaling has been improved for widescreen monitors.
- small stability and error logging updates
- small improvements to the French and Spanish localization

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Big Localization Update!
notes.content:
Added the following localizations to the game:
- French (Thank you to Noé "Ralekk" Krug)
- Italian (Thank you to Fabio Massarenti)
- Japanese (Thank you to Uwaaaa)
- Spanish (Thank you to Francesco Collado)


This update also contains the following changes:
- the players pickup range now increases over 1 second when holding the collect button to make picking up large resource piles easier
- fixed a small glitch that allowed resource duping with the storage boxes
- minor bugfixes and stability improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 - Scroll Buttons
notes.content: Added Scroll Buttons to recipe selection windows for easier scrolling when playing with a gamepad

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 - Small Balance Change for Phials
notes.content:
- The amount of glass needed to produce a phial was decreased from 5 to 3.
- Added a small information after unlocking charcoal to tell the player, that it can also be used as a much better fuel than wood.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 Storage Chests!
notes.content:
Storage Chests have been added to the game as an additional building.
After building a storage chest you can store up to 100 resources of a single type in the chest and retrieve them by clicking.

If any problems come up, please report them in the Steam forum or contact me on Discord

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.9
notes.content: - Fixed a bug introduced by the last hotfix: You can no longer put infinite fuel into the fuel storage.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.8 resource drop issues
notes.content:
- Adjusted the code for dropping resources to fix issues some players were having with putting resources into buildings. (Steam forum users suggested turning off VSync in the options, should the issue persist.)
- Small bugfix to prevent interacting with resources when the game is paused.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.7
notes.content: Just a small QoL Fix: The mouse cursor will now only be locked to the screen when in exclusive fullscreen mode or when edge panning is enabled.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.6
notes.content:
- Changed controller click behavior with recipe selection windows. Should now be much more consistent.
- Holding the click button during the new game cutscene no longer allows clicking resource nodes before it would actually be enabled
- Added some minor tweaks to improve game stability when spawning/removing/using resources and when disconnecting gamepads or other input devices during play

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.5 - VSync Issues
notes.content:
Some users reported problems with dropping resources into buildings. Turning off VSync in the options was reported to be a working solution, until I can provide a proper fix.

This hotfix also contains a small bugfix that prevents resources from being dropped into multiple buildings, when they overlap.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.4
notes.content:
It's hotfixing time ~~

Fixed some sounds that were not connected to an audio group and were not affected by the sounds settings.
- main menu ocean sounds
- intro BGM and portal sfx
- dialogue typewriter sfx

notes.title: Small Hotfix v1.1.3
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for your amazing support for the release!

This update is just a small hotfix for edge panning: 
- the game now no longer scrolls when your mouse cursor is offscreen (e.g. on a second monitor)
